## Setup

```{r Library}
library(Seurat)
library(magrittr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
```

Params

```{r}
params
```

Create output directory

```{r}
dir.create(params$output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
```

Global variables

```{r Params}
cluster_levels <- c(
  "Fiber",
  "Vessel",
  "Fusiform Early Precursor",
  "Fusiform Organizer",
  "Ray Organizer",
  "Ray Precursor",
  "Fusiform Intermediate Precursor",
  "Ray"
) # this is for fixing cluster levels on the plot
fusiform_lineage <- c(
  "Fusiform Organizer",
  "Fusiform Early Precursor",
  "Fusiform Intermediate Precursor",
  "Vessel",
  "Fiber"
)
ray_lineage <- c(
  "Ray Organizer",
  "Ray Precursor",
  "Ray"
)
ordered_factor <- function(values) {
  factor(
    values,
    levels = c(
      intersect(cluster_levels, unique(values)), 
      setdiff(unique(values), cluster_levels)
    )
  )
}
```

Get one-to-one orthologs

```{r Read tables}
# import orthogroups
orth <- read.csv(params$orthogroup_table)

# Keep complete memberships for the two focal species.
focal_species <- c("PoT", "EuG", "LiC", "TrA")
orth_focal <- orth %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    species_name %in% focal_species,
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

# Count distinct loci contributed by each focal species.
orth_copy_number <- orth_focal %>%
  dplyr::count(
    cluster_id,
    species_name,
    name = "n_loci"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    cluster_id,
    species_name,
    fill = list(n_loci = 0L)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = species_name,
    values_from = n_loci
  )

# Retain groups containing exactly one PoT locus and one EuG locus.
single_copy_groups <- orth_copy_number[
  matrixStats::rowAlls(orth_copy_number[, focal_species] == 1),
  "cluster_id"
]

# One row per orthogroup, with the corresponding gene from each species.
orth_single_copy <- orth_focal %>%
  dplyr::semi_join(
    single_copy_groups, 
    by = "cluster_id"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = cluster_id,
    names_from = species_name,
    values_from = gene_name
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    cluster_id
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    cluster_id = cluster_id,
    egr = EuG,
    lch = LiC,
    ptr = PoT,
    tar = TrA
  )

head(orth_single_copy)
```

## Seurat preprocessing

Load & Normalize data

```{r Load and normalize data}
seurat_obj_list <- apply(sample_manifest, 1, function(x){
  sample_name <- x[[1]]
  path_10x_h5 <- file.path(x[2], "outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5")
  stopifnot(file.exists(path_10x_h5))
  seurat_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(
    Read10X_h5(path_10x_h5),
    project = sample_name
  )
  seurat_obj <- NormalizeData(seurat_obj, verbose = FALSE)
  seurat_obj <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat_obj, verbose = FALSE)
  seurat_obj <- ScaleData(seurat_obj, verbose = FALSE)
  seurat_obj <- RunPCA(seurat_obj, verbose = FALSE)
  return(seurat_obj)
})

gc()
names(seurat_obj_list) <- sample_manifest$sample
seurat_obj_list
```

Import reference cell label

```{r Import reference cell label}
seurat_obj_list[[params$reference_bio]]$cell_label <-   
  cell_cluster[Cells(seurat_obj_list[[params$reference_bio]]), "Name"]
table(seurat_obj_list[[params$reference_bio]]$cell_label)
```

## Transfer cell label to each query

```{r Transfer cell label}
for (s in sample_manifest$sample) {
  if (s == params$reference_bio) {
    message("Skipping self")
    next
  } 
  
  # find transfer anchors
  anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(
    reference = seurat_obj_list[[params$reference_bio]], 
    query = seurat_obj_list[[s]]
  )

  # transfer labels
  predictions <- TransferData(
    anchorset = anchors, 
    refdata = seurat_obj_list[[params$reference_bio]]$cell_label
  )
  colnames(predictions) %<>% paste0("pre.", .)
  seurat_obj_list[[s]] <- AddMetaData(object = seurat_obj_list[[s]], metadata = predictions)
}
```

## Integrate samples

Merge object

```{r Merge object}
query_names <- sample_manifest$sample[sample_manifest$sample != params$reference_bio]
seurat_obj <- merge(
  seurat_obj_list[[params$reference_bio]],
  y = seurat_obj_list[query_names],
  add.cell.id = c(params$reference_bio, query_names)
)
```

Inspect prediction scores

```{r Inspect prediction scores}
data_plot <- data.frame(
  score = seurat_obj$pre.prediction.score.max,
  cell_label = factor(seurat_obj$pre.predicted.id, levels = cluster_levels)
)
ggplot(
    data_plot,
    aes(
      x = score,
      fill = cell_label
    )
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~cell_label, ncol = 3) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 50,
    position = position_stack()
  ) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = params$prediction_score,
    color = "red"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

Transfer predicted id where score max > `params$prediction_score`

```{r Transfer predicted id}
seurat_obj$is_ref <- ifelse(seurat_obj$orig.ident == params$reference_bio, "reference", "query")
seurat_obj$cell_label[seurat_obj$is_ref == "query"] <- NA
cell_confidently_annotated <- which(seurat_obj$pre.prediction.score.max > params$prediction_score)
seurat_obj$cell_label[cell_confidently_annotated] <- seurat_obj$pre.predicted.id[cell_confidently_annotated]
seurat_obj$cell_label <- ordered_factor(seurat_obj$cell_label)
```

```{r}
cell_comp <- table(

p_cell_type_comp
```

Integration

```{r Integration}
seurat_obj <- IntegrateLayers(
  seurat_obj, 
  method = CCAIntegration, 
  orig.reduction = "pca",
  new.reduction = "integrated.cca", 
  verbose = FALSE
)
merged_obj <- JoinLayers(seurat_obj)
```

Visualize after integration

```{r Visualize after integration}
seurat_obj <- RunUMAP(
  seurat_obj, 
  dims = 1:30,

  reduction.name = "integrated.umap"
)
p_umap_intergrated <- DimPlot(
    seurat_obj,

    group.by = "cell_label",
    split.by = "is_ref"
  ) +

    palette = "Set1"
  ) + 
  theme_void()

p_umap_intergrated
```

## Identify cell type marker genes

Import the helper script

```{r}
source("notebooks/scripts/Pairwise-marker-curation.R")
```

Define the function for calling Seurat::DotPlot

```{r}
plot_orthomarkers <- function(
    obj,
    genes, 
    target,
    by_sample = TRUE,
    page = 1L, 
    genes_per_page = 25L
  ) {
  if (length(genes) == 0L) {
    stop("No available markers for: ", target)
  }

  n_pages <- ceiling(length(genes) / genes_per_page)
  if (page < 1L || page > n_pages) {
    stop("page must be between 1 and ", n_pages)
  }

  # Paginate only for display; no additional marker filtering.
  index <- seq.int(
    (page - 1L) * genes_per_page + 1L,
    min(page * genes_per_page, length(genes))
  )
  
  Idents(obj) <- rep("plot", ncol(obj))
  obj$cell_label <- factor(obj$cell_label, levels = c(fusiform_lineage, ray_lineage))
  DotPlot(
    object = obj,
    assay = "RNA",
    features = genes[index],
    group.by = "cell_label",
    split.by = if (by_sample) "orig.ident" else NULL,
    cols = "Blues",
    scale = TRUE,
    dot.min = 0
  ) +
    scale_color_gradientn(
      colours = c("grey95", "#9ecae1", "#3182bd", "#08519c")
    ) +
    RotatedAxis() +
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        target, " markers — page ", page, "/", n_pages
      ),
      x = NULL,
      y = if (by_sample) "Transferred label × sample" else "Transferred label",
      colour = "log1p(mean\nnormalized expression)"
    )
}
```

Find cluster markers by pairwise comparison

```{r}
pw <- pairwise_cluster_markers(
  merged_obj,
  label_col = "cell_label"
)

saveRDS(pw, "pairwise-cluster-markers.rds")
```

### Extract cluster candidate marker genes

```{r}
for (target in c(fusiform_lineage, ray_lineage)) {
  rp <- inspect_marker_overlap(
    pw,
    target = target,
    min_log2fc = 1,
    min_target_pct = 0.25,
    alpha = 0.05,
    top_n = 3
  )
  rp$coverage       # Number of passing genes against each competing label
  rp$overlap        # Overlap between the pairwise marker sets
  rp$intersection   # Genes passing against EVERY other label
  rp$membership     # Which comparisons each candidate passes
  
  # plot expression
  if (nrow(rp$candidates) > 0L) {
    p <- plot_orthomarkers(
      merged_obj,
      rp$candidates[["gene"]],
      target,
      page = 1,
      genes_per_page = 30,
      by_sample = TRUE
    )
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(params$output_dir, sprintf("%s.png", target)),
      plot = p,
      units = "in",
      height = 14,
      width = 6 + nrow(rp$candidates) / 3,
      dpi = 600
    )
  }
  
  # output candidates
  candidate_out <- left_join(rp$candidates, annot_info, by = "gene")
  write.csv(
    candidate_out,
    file.path(params$output_dir, sprintf("%s.csv", target)),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}
```

Export SeuratObject

```{r}
saveRDS(merged_obj, file.path(params$output_dir, "merged_obj.rds"))
```
